# Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae — hieroglyphic/hieratic lexicon

## Identity, edition and scope

Selected witness: TLA, Corpus edition 20, web app 2.5.2, 20 August 2026. The rn entry is edited by AV Wortschatz der ägyptischen Sprache, with Lisa Seelau and Simon D. Schweitzer; the site identifies the Berlin-Brandenburg and Saxon academies’ corpus editors. Selection here is lemma 94700, not its separate Demotic successor. Read lemma identity, translations, grammatical class, source reference, dating label and citation metadata; no claim to reading its thousands of linked sentences.

## Consulted carriers

- tla-rn-94700: https://thesaurus-linguae-aegyptiae.de/lemma/94700. Saved HTML `working/sources-texts-references/primary-texts/E4-arabic-egyptian-2026-09-08/tla-rn-94700.html`; SHA-256 `3b3ebaba6492c2d5222741268cc58a8f4473c3f25a9d4afaa76ef644a25a7586`.

No sibling NOTES existed on admission; none was created. The full saved object does not imply a full-work or corpus audit. All below are paraphrases, not quotation-ready transcriptions.

### tla-hieroglyphic-hieratic-lexicon-p001 — Rn, name

**Paraphrase:** The hieroglyphic/hieratic lemma identifies rn as a masculine common noun for name and points to Wörterbuch II, 425.1–428.19.

**Locator:** TLA lemma 94700, lexical header and bibliographical references.

**Provenance:** TLA rn entry; saved tla-rn-94700.html, corpus edition 20. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** A lexical gloss does not itself establish a doctrine of personhood. The displayed 2532 BCE–324 CE corpus attestation range is neither the date of Reri’s papyrus nor a full history of the word; no reconstructed pronunciation is asserted.
